hooks.command: ls ~/workspace/Goo-wiki/CLAUDE.md >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '✓ Goo-wiki vault ready' || echo '⚠ Goo-wiki not found — 使用 .goo/obsidian/ fallback'

python3 -c 'import json,os;p=json.load(open(".goo/plan.json")) if os.path.exists(".goo/plan.json") else {};steps=[s for s in p.get("steps",[]) if s.get("status") not in ("completed","failed")];print("⚠ 发现未完成任务 (%d/%d 步), 输入 /auto-goo:goo-continue 继续" % (len(steps), len(p.get("steps",[])))) if steps else None'
